name: nebula-genomics-assessment
description: Ops dashboard for the genomics kit lifecycle: pipeline health, stage turnaround, stuck kits and order drill-down.
author: Robert Hill

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w frontend && npm run build -w backend
scripts.start: npm run build -w frontend && npm run start:prod -w backend
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w backend && npm run lint -w frontend
scripts.lint:fix: npm run lint:fix -w backend && npm run lint:fix -w frontend
scripts.format: prettier --write "*.{json,md,yml,yaml}" "api/**/*.ts" && npm run format -w backend && npm run format -w frontend
scripts.format:check: prettier --check "*.{json,md,yml,yaml}" "api/**/*.ts" && npm run format:check -w backend && npm run format:check -w frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w backend && npm run typecheck -w frontend
scripts.test: npm run test -w backend && npm run test -w frontend
